en.text:
Requires a <solar/>Solar Super to be equipped to function.

Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 18%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 26%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 40%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 60%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 80%
• Bosses: 100% 
• Players: 30%

Weapon Kills while standing in a Healing Rift grant 7 seconds (10 with <solar/>Ember of Solace) of <solar/>Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

Weapon Kills while standing in an Empowering Rift grant <solar/>Cure x1 to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

<solar/>Daybreak Kills grant <solar/>Cure x2 and 10 seconds (15 with <solar/>Ember of Solace) of <solar/>Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.
